title: The Birthday Party
summary: A family prepares a birthday party with simple past-tense actions.

paragraphs.pt: No sábado, a família de Sofia preparou uma festa surpresa para o aniversário dela. A mãe, Renata, fez um bolo de chocolate, o pai comprou refrigerante, e o irmão, Caio, pendurou balões coloridos na sala. Todos falaram baixo para Sofia não desconfiar.
paragraphs.en: On Saturday, Sofia's family prepared a surprise party for her birthday. Her mother, Renata, made a chocolate cake, her father bought soda, and her brother, Caio, hung colorful balloons in the living room. Everyone spoke quietly so Sofia would not suspect anything.

paragraphs.pt: Sofia chegou às quatro horas e encontrou os amigos cantando parabéns. Ela ficou emocionada, porque achou que ninguém tinha lembrado da data. Quando viu sua avó segurando uma vela pequena, começou a rir e a chorar ao mesmo tempo.
paragraphs.en: Sofia arrived at four o'clock and found her friends singing happy birthday. She was moved because she thought no one had remembered the date. When she saw her grandmother holding a small candle, she began to laugh and cry at the same time.

paragraphs.pt: Depois, Sofia abriu os presentes e agradeceu a cada pessoa. À noite, a família limpou a casa, mas guardou um pedaço de bolo na geladeira. Sofia disse que aquele foi o melhor aniversário dos últimos anos, não pelos presentes, mas pelo carinho.
paragraphs.en: Then Sofia opened the gifts and thanked each person. At night, the family cleaned the house, but saved a piece of cake in the refrigerator. Sofia said that it was the best birthday of recent years, not because of the gifts, but because of the affection.

comprehension.question: What kind of party did Sofia's family prepare?
Where did the family keep a piece of cake?
